title: Decoding the Nested Input
statement: For arbitrary bit strings $x,U,t,a,j,p$, form the nested encoding $\langle\langle x,U\rangle,\langle\langle t,a\rangle,\langle j,p\rangle\rangle$. Applying the total second projection, then the total first projection, then the marker-dropping transducer to this encoding yields the result of applying that transducer to $U$.
